LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 颱風過後的早晨 · Morning after the typhoon

text.traditional: 家豪，昨晚的颱風風雨好大，你家還好嗎？
text.simplified: 家豪，昨晚的台风风雨好大，你家还好吗？
text.english: Jiahao, last night's typhoon had such fierce wind and rain; is your home alright?

text.traditional: 別提了，半夜風大得把路樹都吹倒了，我家甚至還停電了兩三個小時！
text.simplified: 别提了，半夜风大得把路树都吹倒了，我家甚至还停电了两三个小时！
text.english: Don't mention it; in the middle of the night the wind was so strong it blew down street trees, and my house even had a blackout for two or three hours!

text.traditional: 幸好我家平時就準備了電池和手電筒，萬一停電也不用慌張。
text.simplified: 幸好我家平时就准备了电池和手电筒，万一停电也不用慌张。
text.english: Fortunately my family prepared batteries and flashlights in advance; in case of a power outage we don't need to panic.

text.traditional: 我一連打了好幾通電話給住在花蓮的表哥，但電話一直打不通，真讓人擔心。
text.simplified: 我一连打了好几通电话给住在花莲的表哥，但电话一直打不通，真让人担心。
text.english: I called my cousin living in Hualien several times in a row, but couldn't get through; it really makes one worried.

text.traditional: 我以為東部的情況會好一些，沒想到這次颱風在東部登陸，災情相當嚴重。
text.simplified: 我以为东部的情况会好一些，没想到这次台风在东部登陆，灾情相当严重。
text.english: I thought the situation in the east would be better, but unexpectedly this typhoon made landfall in the east, causing severe damage.

text.traditional: 新聞說花蓮部分山區發生了土石流，甚至連對外聯絡的鐵路也被大水沖斷了。
text.simplified: 新闻说花莲部分山区发生了土石流，甚至连对外联络的铁路也被大水冲断了。
text.english: News reports say mudslides occurred in parts of Hualien's mountains, and even the railway connecting outside was washed out by floodwaters.

text.traditional: 氣象局說後面可能還有另一個颱風形成，我們趁今天天氣放晴，也好趕快去超市補充足夠的乾糧和飲用水。
text.simplified: 气象局说后面可能还有另一个台风形成，我们趁今天天气放晴，也好赶快去超市补充足够的干糧和饮用水。
text.english: The weather bureau says another typhoon might form later; while the weather clears up today, it might be good for us to hurry to the supermarket to restock dry food and drinking water.

text.traditional: 好！我們一起去超市採購防颱物資吧。
text.simplified: 好！我们一起去超市采购防台物资吧。
text.english: Great! Let's go to the supermarket together to purchase typhoon prevention supplies.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 九二一地震與臺灣的韌性 · The 921 Earthquake and Taiwan's Resilience
grammarFocus: 以東 / 以西 / 以南 / 以北

text.traditional: 臺灣位於環太平洋地震帶上，板塊運動活躍，因此地震發生的頻率相當高。
text.simplified: 台湾位于环太平洋地震带上，板块运动活躍，因此地震发生的频率相当高。
text.english: Taiwan is located on the Circum-Pacific seismic belt with active plate tectonics, hence earthquake frequency is quite high.

text.traditional: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，臺灣中部發生了規模七點三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.simplified: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，台湾中部发生了规模七点三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.english: In the early morning of September 21, 1999, a magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck central Taiwan, known historically as the '921 Earthquake.'

text.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家庭的家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生，上萬棟房屋倒塌。
text.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家庭的家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生，上万栋房屋倒塌。
text.english: That night's violent shaking shattered homes of many families, resulting unfortunately in more than 2,000 fatalities and thousands of collapsed houses.

text.traditional: 地震發生後，臺中與南投等重災區交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
text.simplified: 地震发生后，台中与南投等重灾区交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
text.english: After the earthquake, transportation in hard-hit areas such as Taichung and Nantou was severed, and even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

text.traditional: 面對巨大的天災，全臺灣人民發揮了「有錢出錢、有力出力」的精神，國內外救援隊伍也迅速投入救災。
text.simplified: 面对巨大的天灾，全台湾人民发挥了「有钱出钱、有力出力」的精神，国内外救援队伍也迅速投入救灾。
text.english: Confronting this massive natural disaster, all Taiwanese displayed the spirit of 'contributing money and labor,' and rescue teams from home and abroad rapidly joined disaster relief.

text.traditional: 車站以南的中部災民在社會各界的溫暖支持下，齊心協力重建家園，展現了無比堅韌的生命力。
text.simplified: 车站以南的中部灾民在社会各界的温暖支持下，齐心协力重建家园，展现了无比坚韌的生命力。
text.english: Victims in central Taiwan south of the station rebuilt their homes with united efforts under warm support from all sectors of society, demonstrating immense resilience.

LESSON_FIVE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · Earthquakes and Typhoons

grammarPages.titleEnglish: In Case / If by Any Chance
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Prepare for unexpected contingencies or emergencies using 萬一.
grammarPages.explanation: 萬一 indicates an unforeseen possibility or contingency (usually an unfavorable situation), emphasizing precautions or countermeasures.

items.question: Does 萬一 express high or low probability?
items.answer: 萬一 indicates an unforeseen, low-probability contingency (often unfavorable), requiring preparation.

right.traditional: 明天萬一下雨就帶雨傘吧。
right.simplified: 明天万一下雨就带雨伞吧。
right.pinyin: Míngtiān wànyī xiàyǔ jiù dài yǔsǎn ba.
right.english: In case it rains tomorrow, bring an umbrella.

items.question: Can 萬一 stand after the consequence?
items.answer: 萬一 introduces the contingency clause first, followed by the countermeasure.

right.pinyin: Wànyī xiàyǔ, jiù dài yǔsǎn ba.
right.english: If by chance it rains, take an umbrella.

text.traditional: 出國旅遊前最好先買個旅遊平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外，就不必擔心醫藥費了。
text.simplified: 出国旅游前最好先买个旅游平安保险，万一发生什么意外，就不必担心医药费了。
text.pinyin: Chūguó lǚyóu qián zuì hǎo xiān mǎi ge lǚyóu píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài, jiù búbì dānxīn yīyàofèi le.
text.english: Before traveling abroad you had best buy travel safety insurance; in case any accident happens, you won't need to worry about medical costs.

text.traditional: 我家裡平時都準備了一些蠟燭、電池什麼的，萬一停電了，才不會手忙腳亂。
text.simplified: 我家里平时都准备了一些蜡烛、电池什么的，万一停电了，才不会手忙脚乱。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ píngshí dōu zhǔnbèi le yìxiē làzhú, diànchí shénme de, wànyī tíngdiàn le, cái bú huì shǒumángjiǎoluàn.
text.english: My family usually prepares candles, batteries and such; in case of a blackout, we won't panic.

words.english: candle (M: 根 gēn, 枝 zhī)

text.traditional: 出門前記得把門窗關好，萬一下起暴雨，雨水才不會飄進客廳。
text.simplified: 出门前记得把门窗关好，万一下起暴雨，雨水才不会飄进客厅。
text.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìde bǎ ménchuāng guān hǎo, wànyī xià qǐ bàoyǔ, yǔshuǐ cái bú huì piāo jìn kètīng.
text.english: Remember to close doors and windows before going out; in case it starts pouring, rain won't blow into the living room.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 登山前一定要帶足夠的飲水和地圖，___迷路了才能自救。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express actions or states occurring uninterrupted in sequence using 一連.
grammarPages.explanation: 一連 indicates that an action, event, or condition persists continuously over a succession of days, times, or iterations without break.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一連 + Duration / Frequency + Action

complement.traditional: 說了好幾個難懂的句子。
complement.simplified: 说了好几个难懂的句子。

items.question: Can 一連 be used without a number or time quantifier?
items.answer: No. 一連 requires an explicit number of days, weeks, or times (一連三天, 一連五次).

right.pinyin: Tā yìlián kàn le sān tiān diànshì.
right.english: He watched TV for three days in a row.

items.question: How does 一連 differ from 一直?
items.answer: 一直 emphasizes unbroken state without counting; 一連 stresses unbroken count of units.
items.wrongTraditional: 我一連住在這裡很多年。
items.wrongSimplified: 我一连住在这里很多年。

text.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個我聽不懂的專業術語，他說的到底是什麼意思呢？
text.simplified: 他一连说了好几个我听不懂的专业术语，他说的到底是什么意思呢？
text.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎo jǐ ge wǒ tīng bù dǒng de zhuānyè shùyǔ, tā shuō de dàodǐ shì shénme yìsi ne?
text.english: He spoke several technical terms in a row that I couldn't understand; what on earth did he mean?

text.traditional: 我最近忙著趕專案進度，已經一連三個週末都加班了。
text.simplified: 我最近忙着赶专案进度，已经一连三个周末都加班了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn máng zhe gǎn zhuān'àn jìndù, yǐjīng yìlián sān ge zhōumò dōu jiābān le.
text.english: Recently I've been busy rushing project progress, and have worked overtime for three weekends in a row.

text.traditional: 連續下了好幾天的雨，這條河流的水位一連上漲了三公尺。
text.simplified: 连续下了好几天的雨，这条河流的水位一连上涨了三公尺。
text.pinyin: Liánxù xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de yǔ, zhè tiáo héliú de shuǐwèi yìlián shàngzhǎng le sān gōngchǐ.
text.english: It rained continuously for several days, and the water level of this river rose three meters in a row.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 球隊隊長發揮出色，___投進了三顆三分球！

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast an initial mistaken assumption with unexpected reality using 以為…沒想到….
grammarPages.explanation: 以為 introduces an assumption that turns out to be contrary to reality, while 沒想到 introduces the surprising factual outcome.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以為 + Expectation + 沒想到 + Reality

complement.traditional: 沒想到他們連嚐都不肯。
complement.simplified: 没想到他们连尝都不肯。

items.question: Can 以為 be used when the belief was correct?
items.answer: 以為 strongly implies the assumption was mistaken; use 認為 for holding a correct or neutral view.
items.wrongTraditional: 我以為他是台灣人，結果他真的是台灣人。
items.wrongSimplified: 我以为他是台湾人，结果他真的是台湾人。

right.traditional: 我以為他是台灣人，沒想到他是日本人。
right.simplified: 我以为他是台湾人，没想到他是日本人。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā shì Táiwān rén, méi xiǎngdào tā shì Rìběn rén.
right.english: I thought he was Taiwanese; unexpectedly, he is Japanese.

items.question: Can 沒想到 precede the mistaken assumption?
items.answer: No. 以為 introduces the mistaken thought first, then 沒想到 reveals the surprise fact.
items.wrongTraditional: 沒想到他是日本人我以為。
items.wrongSimplified: 没想到他是日本人我以为。

right.traditional: 我以為很簡單，沒想到這麼難。
right.simplified: 我以为很简单，没想到这么难。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi hěn jiǎndān, méi xiǎngdào zhème nán.
right.english: I thought it was simple, unexpectedly it's so difficult.

text.traditional: 我以為東部的情況會好一些，沒想到這次颱風在東部登陸，災情相當嚴重。
text.simplified: 我以为东部的情况会好一些，没想到这次台风在东部登陆，灾情相当严重。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi dōngbù de qíngkuàng huì hǎo yìxiē, méi xiǎngdào zhè cì táifēng zài dōngbù dēnglù, zāiqíng xiāngdāng yánzhòng.
text.english: I thought eastern Taiwan's situation would be better; unexpectedly this typhoon made landfall in the east, causing severe damage.

text.traditional: 王媽媽以為這道新菜孩子們一定搶著吃，沒想到他們連嚐都不肯嚐。
text.simplified: 王妈妈以为这道新菜孩子们一定抢着吃，没想到他们连尝都不肯尝。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma yǐwéi zhè dào xīn cài háizi men yídìng qiǎng zhe chī, méi xiǎngdào tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng.
text.english: Mother Wang thought the children would vie to eat this new dish, but unexpectedly they refused to even taste it.

text.traditional: 我以為中文文法很難學，沒想到掌握了規律之後，越學越有成就感。
text.simplified: 我以为中文文法很难学，没想到掌握了规律之后，越学越有成就感。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhōngwén wénfǎ hěn nán xué, méi xiǎngdào zhǎowò le guīlǜ zhīhòu, yuè xué yuè yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
text.english: I thought Chinese grammar would be very difficult to learn; unexpectedly after grasping the patterns, the more I study the more rewarding it feels.

questions.prompt: 我___今天會議會取消，___大家都準時出席了。

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Might As Well / That Works Too
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Accept or endorse a practical proposal using 也好.
grammarPages.explanation: 也好 placed at the end of a clause expresses approval or resignation toward a proposal, indicating that it is a sensible or beneficial course of action.

items.question: Where does clause-final 也好 sit?
items.answer: 也好 stands at the end of the proposed clause, conveying supportive approval.

right.english: It works well if we go tomorrow.

items.question: Does 也好 indicate strong preference or pleasant acceptance?
items.answer: 也好 indicates pragmatic agreement or acceptance of an alternative, not the sole best choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 我最喜歡這件，也好買它。
items.wrongSimplified: 我最喜欢这件，也好买它。

right.traditional: 要是沒時間，買現成的也好。
right.simplified: 要是没时间，买现成的也好。
right.pinyin: Yàoshi méi shíjiān, mǎi xiànchéng de yě hǎo.
right.english: If there's no time, buying ready-made works too.

text.traditional: 氣象局說後面還有颱風，我們趁今天放晴去超市多買些乾糧也好。
text.simplified: 气象局说后面还有台风，我们趁今天放晴去超市多买些干糧也好。
text.pinyin: Qìxiàngjú shuō hòumiàn hái yǒu táifēng, wǒmen chèn jīntiān fàngqíng qù chāoshì duō mǎi xiē gānliáng yě hǎo.
text.english: The weather bureau says another typhoon is behind; it might as well be good for us to take advantage of today's clear skies to buy dry provisions.

text.traditional: 既然戶外活動取消了，大家趁這個機會留在家裡看書、充實自己也好。
text.simplified: 既然户外活动取消了，大家趁这个机会留在家里看书、充实自己也好。
text.pinyin: Jìrán hùwài huódòng qǔxiāo le, dàjiā chèn zhège jīhuì liú zài jiā lǐ kànshū, chōngshí zìjǐ yě hǎo.
text.english: Since outdoor activities are canceled, everyone staying home to read and enrich themselves might be good too.

text.traditional: 兒子問媽媽：我可以找朋友來我們社區烤肉嗎？媽媽笑著說：也好，熱鬧一下！
text.simplified: 儿子问妈妈：我可以找朋友来我们社区烤肉吗？妈妈笑着说：也好，热闹一下！
text.pinyin: Érzi wèn māma: Wǒ kěyǐ zhǎo péngyǒu lái wǒmen shèqū kǎoròu ma? Māma xiào zhe shuō: Yě hǎo, rènào yíxià!
text.english: Son asked mother: Can I invite friends to barbecue in our community? Mother smiled and said: That works too, add some festive cheer!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 也好 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 外面風大，既然不想出去散步，就在家做做伸展操___。

grammarPages.titleEnglish: As a Result / Turned Out That
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Indicate an outcome or unexpected consequence of a previous action using 結果.
grammarPages.explanation: 結果 serves as a conjunction or noun introducing the eventual result of an action, frequently signaling an unanticipated or contrary outcome.

items.question: Can 結果 introduce the intention instead of outcome?
items.answer: No. 結果 marks the actual final result or consequence, often an unintended one.
items.wrongTraditional: 我想去看電影，結果是我的打算。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想去看电影，结果是我的打算。

right.traditional: 我想去買票，結果票已經賣完了。
right.simplified: 我想去买票，结果票已经卖完了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi piào, jiéguǒ piào yǐjīng màiwán le.
right.english: I wanted to buy a ticket, but as it turned out, tickets were already sold out.

items.question: How does 結果 differ from 所以?
items.answer: 所以 gives a direct logical reason-and-result; 結果 highlights the factual turn of events.
items.wrongTraditional: 因為下雨，結果我帶雨傘。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为下雨，结果我带雨伞。

right.traditional: 因為下雨，所以我帶雨傘。
right.simplified: 因为下雨，所以我带雨伞。
right.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dài yǔsǎn.
right.english: Because it rained, I brought an umbrella.

text.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生。
text.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生。
text.pinyin: Nà yí yè qiángliè de yáohuàng zhènsuì le xǔduō jiāyuán, jiéguǒ zàochéng le liǎng qiān duō rén búxìng sàngshēng.
text.english: That night's violent shaking shattered many homes, resulting unfortunately in over 2,000 fatalities.

text.traditional: 昨天我在夜市看上一件上衣，沒試穿就買了，結果回家穿上才發現尺寸太小。
text.simplified: 昨天我在夜市看上一件上衣，没试穿就买了，结果回家穿上才发现尺寸太小。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yèshì kànshàng yí jiàn shàngyī, méi shìchuān jiù mǎi le, jiéguǒ huíjiā chuān shàng cái fāxiàn chǐcùn tài xiǎo.
text.english: Yesterday I took a fancy to a top at the night market and bought it without trying it on; as a result, I only found out it was too small after getting home.

text.traditional: 這幾個月很多人因為流感而住院了，我和家人出門都戴口罩，結果一整個冬天都沒生病。
text.simplified: 这几个月很多人因为流感而住院了，我和家人出门都戴口罩，结果一整个冬天都没生病。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè hěn duō rén yīnwèi liúgǎn ér zhùyuàn le, wǒ hé jiārén chūmén dōu dài kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ yì zhěng ge dōngtiān dōu méi shēngbìng.
text.english: These months many people were hospitalized for flu; my family and I wore masks when going out, and as a result didn't fall ill the entire winter.

questions.prompt: 他昨天熬夜趕工看球賽，___今天上班遲到了。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an extreme or surprising example for emphasis using 甚至.
grammarPages.explanation: 甚至 introduces an extreme instance or unexpected escalation of a situation, often reinforced with 連…也/都….

items.question: Does 甚至 indicate an ordinary addition like 而且?
items.answer: 甚至 escalates to an extreme, surprising, or superlative degree beyond normal expectations.
items.wrongTraditional: 他會說英文甚至會說中文。
items.wrongSimplified: 他会说英文甚至会说中文。

right.traditional: 他會多種語言，甚至連古希臘文都懂。
right.simplified: 他会多种语言，甚至连古希腊文都懂。
right.pinyin: Tā huì duō zhǒng yǔyán, shènzhì lián gǔ xīlàwén dōu dǒng.
right.english: He knows multiple languages, he even understands Ancient Greek.

items.question: Where does 甚至 sit in relation to 連?
items.answer: 甚至 precedes 連 when paired together (甚至連…也/都…), escalating emphasis.

text.traditional: 地震過後，臺中與南投交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
text.simplified: 地震过后，台中与南投交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
text.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu, Táizhōng yǔ Nántóu jiāotōng zhōngduàn, shènzhì lián shuǐdiàn hé tōngxùn yě wánquán tānhuàn.
text.english: After the earthquake, transport in Taichung and Nantou was severed; even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

text.traditional: 張小姐什麼動物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至連電視上的蛇圖片也害怕。
text.simplified: 张小姐什么动物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至连电视上的蛇图片也害怕。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shénme dòngwù dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà shé, shènzhì lián diànshì shàng de shé túpiàn yě hàipà.
text.english: Miss Zhang isn't afraid of any animals except snakes; she is even afraid of snake pictures on TV.

text.traditional: 馬老闆一忙起來，不但沒空吃飯，甚至連上廁所的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 马老闆一忙起来，不但没空吃饭，甚至连上厕所的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Mǎ lǎobǎn yì máng qǐlái, búdàn méi kòng chīfàn, shènzhì lián shàng cèsuǒ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: Once Boss Ma gets busy, not only does he have no time to eat, he doesn't even have time to go to the restroom.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 這家咖啡館生意火爆，排隊隊伍長達百米，___驚動了新聞媒體前來採訪。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Designate a geographic direction or area relative to a landmark using 以東/以西/以南/以北.
grammarPages.explanation: These directional compass terms denote the area or boundary lying to the east, west, south, or north of a specific geographical landmark.
grammarPages.pattern: Landmark + 以東 / 以西 / 以南 / 以北

complement.traditional: 有許多歷史悠久的古蹟。
complement.simplified: 有许多历史悠久的古迹。

items.question: Can 以東/西/南/北 stand without a landmark?
items.answer: These directional compass zones require a geographical point of reference (Landmark + 以東).

right.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài chēzhàn yǐ dōng.
right.english: We live to the east of the station.

items.question: Does 車站以東 mean only the spot right next to the station?
items.answer: No. Landmark + 以東 denotes the entire regional zone lying eastward of that boundary.
items.wrongTraditional: 他在車站以東的門口等我。
items.wrongSimplified: 他在车站以东的门口等我。

right.pinyin: Tā zài chēzhàn dōng mén děng wǒ.
right.english: He is waiting for me at the station's east gate.

text.traditional: 車站以北的地區比其他地區熱鬧，如果你想逛街購物，那裡真是個好去處。
text.simplified: 车站以北的地区比其他地区热闹，如果你想逛街购物，那里真是个好去处。
text.pinyin: Chēzhàn yǐ běi de dìqū bǐ qítā dìqū rènào, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng guàngjiē gòuwù, nàlǐ zhēn shì ge hǎo qùchù.
text.english: The area north of the station is more bustling than other areas; if you want to shop, that is really a great destination.

text.traditional: 我覺得花蓮市以南到臺東這一段路的風景最美，值得推薦給喜歡旅遊的朋友。
text.simplified: 我觉得花莲市以南到台东这一段路的风景最美，值得推荐给喜欢旅游的朋友。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Huālián Shì yǐ nán dào Táidōng zhè yí duàn lù de fēngjǐng zuì měi, zhíde tuījiàn gěi xǐhuān lǚyóu de péngyǒu.
text.english: I feel the scenery from south of Hualien City to Taitung is the most scenic, well worth recommending to friends who love traveling.

text.traditional: 這個國家以西鄰接著廣闊的沙漠，氣候十分乾燥。
text.simplified: 这个国家以西邻接着广闊的沙漠，气候十分干燥。
text.pinyin: Zhège guójiā yǐ xī línjiē zhe guǎngkuò de shāmò, qìhòu shífēn gānzào.
text.english: To the west of this country borders an expansive desert; the climate is very arid.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 九二一地震與臺灣的韌性 · The 921 Earthquake and Taiwan's Resilience
grammarFocus: 以東 / 以西 / 以南 / 以北

text.traditional: 臺灣位於環太平洋地震帶上，板塊運動活躍，因此地震發生的頻率相當高。
text.simplified: 台湾位于环太平洋地震带上，板块运动活躍，因此地震发生的频率相当高。
text.english: Taiwan is located on the Circum-Pacific seismic belt with active plate tectonics, hence earthquake frequency is quite high.

text.traditional: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，臺灣中部發生了規模七點三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.simplified: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，台湾中部发生了规模七点三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
text.english: In the early morning of September 21, 1999, a magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck central Taiwan, known historically as the '921 Earthquake.'

text.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家庭的家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生，上萬棟房屋倒塌。
text.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家庭的家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生，上万栋房屋倒塌。
text.english: That night's violent shaking shattered homes of many families, resulting unfortunately in more than 2,000 fatalities and thousands of collapsed houses.

text.traditional: 地震發生後，臺中與南投等重災區交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
text.simplified: 地震发生后，台中与南投等重灾区交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
text.english: After the earthquake, transportation in hard-hit areas such as Taichung and Nantou was severed, and even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

text.traditional: 面對巨大的天災，全臺灣人民發揮了「有錢出錢、有力出力」的精神，國內外救援隊伍也迅速投入救災。
text.simplified: 面对巨大的天灾，全台湾人民发挥了「有钱出钱、有力出力」的精神，国内外救援队伍也迅速投入救灾。
text.english: Confronting this massive natural disaster, all Taiwanese displayed the spirit of 'contributing money and labor,' and rescue teams from home and abroad rapidly joined disaster relief.

text.traditional: 車站以南的中部災民在社會各界的溫暖支持下，齊心協力重建家園，展現了無比堅韌的生命力。
text.simplified: 车站以南的中部灾民在社会各界的温暖支持下，齐心协力重建家园，展现了无比坚韌的生命力。
text.english: Victims in central Taiwan south of the station rebuilt their homes with united efforts under warm support from all sectors of society, demonstrating immense resilience.
